page.layout: One page of Latin verse in the main column, with paragraph numbers 10 to 16 in the left margin, then the heading ALITER, the heading CAP. I, and the verse of Cap. I with its numbers in the left margin. The catchword "Ergo" stands at the lower right. The right edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: 10 Quæ reprobis Christum Iudæis causa negarit, Iustitia & legis quæ stet illa docet. Sancta fides nullum cœlo secludit ab alto: Iudæus proprij nam sibi causa mali est.
11 Fallere non possunt summi promissa Tonantis, Siquis promissis possit habere fidem. Nec tamen elatos animos exsollite Gentes, Quippe fidem amissam mœsta ruina manet.
12 Victima quæ verè cœlesti grata parenti, Quæ fidei virtus officiumque docet. Vivite concordes, fucatum pellite amorem, Nec vos vindictæ cæca cupido trahat.
13 Fac sanctum vigili venereris mente Senatum, Nec cedat sancto pectore fratris amor. Tempus abit, celeri fallax pede labitur ætas, Nunc igitur vitæ sit pia cura piæ.
14 Multa dapum fuerant discrimina, multa dierum, Equeis[?] surgebant iurgia multa nimis. Admonet hos igitur nimium ne affectibus illis Permittant curæ sit magis almus amor.
15 Ferte ergo infirmos patienti pectore fratres, Nec moveant duri scripta severa styli. Offendit causam, cur non conuenerit illos. Illorum sancto postulat ore preces.
16 Ultima commendat venientem littera Phæben. Dicatur sanctis fratribus alma salus. Discordes (moneo) doctores pellite semper, Ne veniant lites dissidiumque graue.
main_text.head: ALITER.
CAP. I.
main_text.p: AD vos ire iuvat, sum debitor haud pudeso. Notum haud agnoscit reproba turba Deum.
2 Bis malus est damnans quod agit, distinctio nulla. Intus non foris est lex tua, doctor iners.
3 Conditio Iudæ præstat, peccauimus omnes. Restituitque Deo nos sine lege fides.
4 Datque fides vitam, quam circumcisio signat. Hæc facis heredes, hac nitet ille Pater.

page.notes: The catchword "Ergo" is printed at the lower right, beside a stray printed "5" that I could not place with certainty. The numbers 10 to 16 and 2 to 4 are printed beside the verses in the left margin. "Equeis" in line 14 is doubtful. The page number "208" at the head is doubtful. The right edge shows the neighbouring page (verso/recto text and marginal words) and was not transcribed. The loupe and page stains were ignored.
